name: Gauntlet USDC Prime V1
oneLiner: gtUSDC is the Gauntlet-curated MetaMorpho V1 vault for USDC, an ERC-4626 wrapper compounding USDC lending yield across permissioned Morpho markets.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-07-30 at Ethereum block 25648562. The Blockscout exact-match verified MetaMorpho source (compiler v0.8.21) and all 40 bundled dependencies expose no holder blacklist, freeze, pause, allowlist, or transfer hook; holder transfer/transferFrom are vanilla OpenZeppelin ERC20 paths and the vault never overrides the ERC20 _update hook. The vault is immutable (EIP-1967 implementation slot zero) with owner() the Gauntlet Safe 4/7 0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec, whose reach is limited to vault parameters (fees, caps, timelocks, market allocation) with no holder-transfer gating. The inherited classification is retained: the vault's sole asset is USDC supplied into Morpho markets, so Circle's issuer-side blacklist authority over USDC (failure domain asset:usdc-circle) can freeze the upstream collateral, while gtUSDC shares themselves carry no token-level restriction.

mintAuthority.summary: gtUSDC is an immutable MetaMorpho V1 vault (no proxy); shares minted only against USDC deposits. Vault owner is a Gauntlet Safe 4/7 (v1.3.0). No upgrade path. Base USDC issuance inherited from Circle.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526837, asset() returned USDC (0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48), owner() returned Gauntlet Safe 0xc684c658..., and the EIP-1967 implementation, proxy-admin, and beacon slots were all zero. The direct MetaMorpho V1 code therefore has no implementation-replacement path.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295208: vault is immutable (no EIP-1967 proxy slots), asset()=USDC confirmed, owner=Safe 4/7 v1.3.0 (0xc684c6587712e5e7bdf9fd64415f23bd2b05faec), no modules. Shares minted deposit-only. Base USDC mint authority remains with Circle. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: the immutable MetaMorpho vault can mint shares only against deposited USDC; the inherited base issuer publishes monthly Deloitte reserve examinations. The latest USDC report covers May 2026, and the NYDFS list matches Circle Internet Financial, LLC. M-2 evidence review 2026-08-08: supervision and reconciliation downgraded to the wrapper-level convention (steakusdc precedent) - the coin's issuer of record is the vault curator, which no named prudential regime supervises (jurisdiction is correspondingly empty), and the deposit-only share wrapper is not a separate issuer reserve regime. Circle's NYDFS supervision and monthly Deloitte examinations are facts of the underlying USDC, credited on usdc-circle, not of this wrapper.

collateral: USDC deposited into a Gauntlet-curated MetaMorpho vault on Morpho Blue; the curator allocates across conservative USDC lending markets backed by blue-chip crypto and real-world asset collateral
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 MetaMorpho vault shares appreciate against USDC as borrower interest accrues; withdrawals redeem vault shares for available USDC liquidity or wait for Morpho market liquidity to return

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: gtUSDC has one tracked Ethereum vault contract. The Across/World candidate signal did not resolve to a durable gtUSDC bridge route, so this is reviewed as a native single-chain vault token.
